notes: The school-year Job Mentor Program is a 9th to 12th grade elective that earns 0.5 elective credit each semester. The page says interns earn minimum wage.
name: Job Mentor Program Summer Internship
org: Youth and Family Services, City of Albuquerque
what_you_do: Seven-week paid summer internship with a City department, government agency or nonprofit. You work up to 25 hours a week.
who_can_apply: Albuquerque high school students ages 14 to 18.
pay_detail: Paid. Wage not stated on the program pages.
duration: 7 weeks, up to 25 hours a week
deadline_text: The page gives no spring dates or year for applications. Apply during the spring window on the City's Jobs and Internships page.
how_to_apply: Apply in spring. Use the City's Jobs and Internships page. Questions? Call the Educational Initiatives Office at 505-767-5898.
